chapter_seo_title: Three Nascent Soul Monsters Fight Over Han Li’s Future – Chapter 463
chapter_meta_description: Han Li is offered mentorship, wealth, and even a woman—but every gift is a trap. Which master will he choose, and at what cost?
og_title: Han Li Caught Between Three Monsters
og_description: Three Nascent Soul cultivators compete to claim Han Li as their pawn. The price of saying yes might be worse than the price of saying no.
twitter_description: Loyalty, power, or death? Han Li must pick one master from three deadly options.

lore_anchors.definition: In xianxia, a nominal or probationary disciple has official status but limited rights; the master can dismiss them at will, while the disciple owes obedience.
A legendary, sentient spirit herb that can transform; its alchemical formula is a tightly guarded secret.
An ancient treasure given as a sect token; it provides defense and attack power but is structurally countered by a paired Yang Ring.
A dangerous elemental trial within the Void Heaven Palace, split between red (fire) and blue (ice) zones.
Artifacts designed as complementary opposites; one may empower or suppress the other depending on who holds the dominant half.
